action.description: plan evaluates the safety checks without changing anything. execute starts restoring the source server to a new server; call again with the same parameters to see its state and hostname. The source server is never changed.

serverId.description: Resource ID of the PostgreSQL or MySQL flexible server to restore.

targetServerName.description: Name of the new server to restore into, in the source's resource group. It must not exist yet.

restorePointInTime.description: RFC 3339 time to restore to, between the source's earliest restore point (reported by plan) and now.
